<!-- PageHeader: ![Welcome Week 2026 August 17-21 Main Quad WELCOME WEEK CLUB FAIR](figures/1.1) -->


# Events this week

. Mon 10:00 AM Campus tour. Meet at the steps
of Founders Hall.

. Tue 12:00 PM Club fair on the Main Quad.

. Wed 4:00 PM Financial aid drop-in, Student
Services Room 118.

. Thu 6:30 PM Movie night on the lawn. Bring a
blanket.

. Fri 11:00 AM Free lunch while supplies last.


# Get connected

New to Lakeshore? Join us for orientation and
meet the people who will help you succeed.
Sessions run every morning at 9:00 AM in the
Student Union. Register ahead to save your seat,
or just drop in.

Scan the code to register:

![QRCode](barcodes/1.1 "https://www.example.org/welcome")

or visit https://www.example.org/welcome

Need help?

Student Services is open Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Call (312) 555-0119 or visit Room 118 in
the Student Union.

<!-- PageFooter: Lakeshore Community College is an equal opportunity institution. Fictional sample for software testing. -->

summary.valueString: Flyer for Lakeshore Community College Welcome Week 2026 listing daily events Aug. 17–21 on the Main Quad and other campus locations. It also provides orientation session details, registration link/QR code, and Student Services hours and contact information.
